sections.t: Rest day as planned, with a 2.8 km recovery walk. Week 1 is on track so far: Lower A, Upper A and one easy run done.

Lower B: hip thrust machine 4x6-10, RDL 3x6-10, leg press feet high 3x10-15, cable kickback 3x12-15, side plank. On the RDL, push your hips back and keep the bar close to your legs, stopping when your hamstrings are fully stretched.

Lifting day, so spread about 130 g protein across four meals within roughly 1,750 kcal. Start with a Big omelette on toast and have the Chicken and potato tray bake after the session to refuel for Saturday.
